inlines.v: SPEW, verb transitive [Latin spuo.] 1. To vomit; to puke; to eject from the stomach. 2. To eject; to cast forth. 3. To cast out with abhorrence. Leviticus 18:1. SPEW, verb intransitive To vomit; to discharge the contents of the stomach.
